name: HYDRA-UMC-SAFETY-ZONES
notes: Real v0 zone-breach checking and E-STOP requesting (`check` subcommand): real AABB zone geometry, real Warning/Danger breach detection, and a real EStopRequester interface that only ever requests a stop, never asserts one - honest for a safety service whose enforcement boundary is deliberately outside this repo. Real 3D occupancy mapping from Hailo-8 and the real CAN transport stay future work, both genuinely blocked on hardware this environment does not have.
